comment: Independent C-first clerical caster mission. include/monsters.h:3398 defines role-monster cleric AT_MAGC/AD_CLRC without aligned-cleric epri extension. mcastu.c mon_cleric_spells24-30 selects mcast_blind_you and mcast_insects among paralysis/confusion/lightning effects. Non-Antimagic Healer has materially different armor/HP/innate conditions. Scout actual position, then permit bounded casts; attribute only first defect. Earlier ki-rin is AD_SPEL (include/monsters.h:1247), so it did not test the clerical pool.
